'''MCI-100 magnacuffs''' were a model of [[Magnacuffs/Legends|magnacuffs]] produced by [[Locris Syndicated Securities/Legends|Locris Syndicated Securities]]. It used micro magnetic fields to lock their restraining bands in place. It also employed a fingerprint identification system which eliminated the need for keys and safeguarded against unauthorized duplication.
